verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a customer data platform, since some products of this kind offer self-hosted deployments, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Segment. The materials describe a hosted workspace-based service: Functions run 'within your workspace' with 'no additional infrastructure required', and data storage destinations only export data to the user's warehouse or buckets, which is not self-hosting the product.
